title: Multiplier Accumulator
statement: Build a 4-bit multiplier-accumulator that multiplies two 4-bit unsigned operands and adds the result to an 8-bit accumulator. The accumulator must update on a clock edge and support synchronous reset. This unit is common in DSP datapaths.
module_signature: module multiplier_accumulator(input clk, input rst, input en, input [3:0] a, input [3:0] b, output reg [7:0] acc);
behavior: When en is 1, acc <= acc + (a * b) on the rising edge.
If en is 0, acc retains its value.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not use asynchronous reset or combinational accumulation.
hint: Use a register for acc and compute the product combinationally.
